events.command:
/usr/bin/bash -lc "set -euo pipefail
if [ -e final_answer ]; then
  exit 73
fi
mkdir -p final_answer/metadata final_answer/reads
jq -r '.[] | select(.file_ext == \"fastqsanger.gz\") | [.id, .name] | @tsv' run_trace/galaxy_tool_run_007/outputs/final_datasets.json | xargs -P 8 -n 2 bash -c '
  dataset_id=\""'$1"
  dataset_name="$2"
  case "$dataset_name" in
    *:forward) output_name="${dataset_name%:forward}_1.fastq.gz" ;;
    *:reverse) output_name="${dataset_name%:reverse}_2.fastq.gz" ;;
    *) output_name="${dataset_name}.fastq.gz" ;;
  esac
  curl -fLsS --retry 4 --retry-delay 2 -H "x-api-key: $GALAXY_API_KEY" "$GALAXY_URL/api/datasets/$dataset_id/display" -o "final_answer/reads/$output_name"
'"' _
curl -fLsS --retry 4 --retry-delay 2 -H \"x-api-key: "'$GALAXY_API_KEY" "$GALAXY_URL/api/datasets/f9cad7b01a4721355933597403e5b317/display" -o final_answer/metadata/PRJNA1354216.tsv
curl -fLsS --retry 4 --retry-delay 2 -H "x-api-key: $GALAXY_API_KEY" "$GALAXY_URL/api/datasets/f9cad7b01a4721355af2757d66c6f663/display" -o final_answer/metadata/PRJNA1339024.tsv
find final_answer -type f -printf '"'%P\\t%s\\n' | sort"
